title: The Present Active Participle
subtitle: amāns, amantis. Third-declension adjective in form.
objectives: Form the present active participle from any verb.
Decline the participle as a third-declension adjective.
Translate participles as 'X-ing' or with relative clauses.

sections.heading: The present active participle
sections.body:
Formation: present stem + -ns (becomes -nt- in all cases except nom. sg.):
  amāns, amantis — loving
  regēns, regentis — ruling

Declines like a third-declension adjective (one-termination).

Cicero writes: vir amāns patriae. — A man loving his country.
Caesar writes: mīlitēs pugnantēs. — Soldiers fighting.

items.prompt: Form the present participle of dūcō.

items.answer: A girl singing / the girl who is singing.
